title: ProdCrawl: A Replayable Test Collection for Focused Crawling
abstract: arXiv:2610.40855v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A focused crawler searches for web pages on a specific topic under a constrained download budget. Since it can only fetch a limited number of pages, its success depends on choosing which links to follow. Focused crawlers are usually evaluated on live websites by harvest rate, the fraction of downloaded pages that are relevant. This has two problems: on the one hand, websites change over time, so a crawl cannot be repeated under the same conditions; on the other hand, there is no ground truth for which pages are relevant. As a result, comparisons between crawlers are unreliable. We present ProdCrawl, a replayable test collection for focused crawling. It comprises static mirrors of 621 company and organization websites, about 1.1 million pages, with each page labeled as a product page or non-product page based on a majority vote among three large language models. Any crawler can be run on exactly the same sites and scored against the same

translated_title: ProdCrawl：面向聚焦爬虫的可重放测试集
translated_abstract: 聚焦爬虫在受限的下载预算下搜索特定主题的网页。由于它只能抓取有限数量的页面，其成功取决于选择跟随哪些链接。聚焦爬虫通常通过收获率（即下载页面中相关页面的比例）在实时网站上进行评估。这存在两个问题：一方面，网站随时间变化，因此爬取无法在相同条件下重复进行；另一方面，没有关于哪些页面相关的真实标准。因此，爬虫之间的比较是不可靠的。我们提出了ProdCrawl，一个用于聚焦爬虫的可重放测试集。它包含621个公司和组织网站的静态镜像，约110万个页面，每个页面基于三个大型语言模型的多数投票被标记为产品页面或非产品页面。任何爬虫都可以在完全相同的网站上运行，并根据相同的
tldr: ProdCrawl是一个可重放的聚焦爬虫测试集，包含621个网站约110万个页面的静态镜像，并由三个大语言模型投票标注每个页面，解决了传统评估方法中爬取结果不可重复、缺乏真实标注标准的问题。
en_tdlr: ProdCrawl is a replayable test collection for focused crawling, comprising static mirrors of 621 websites with about 1.1 million pages labeled via majority voting of three LLMs, addressing the problems of unrepeatability and lack of ground truth in traditional crawler evaluation.
